synopsis: AVL is classified as an engineering service company with vehicle models and scenario tooling, rather than a complete simulation platform; its offerings include SCENIUS, scenario-based validation and tool-chain integration [f15919, f8802, f8803]. Its off-road engineering spans agriculture, forestry, construction and mining, with GOAS demonstrated on a retrofitted tractor using lidar, radar, camera, GPS and IMU [f8687, f8800, f8805]. In April 2023, AVL coupled CARLA, VSM vehicle dynamics and a soft-soil tire model for autonomous-tractor testing, but the corpus treats this only as an integration precedent; dedicated off-road evidence for SCENIUS was not found [f8475, f9189]. AVL claims VSM model correlation of up to 97%, and appears as an integration and correlation partner in the highest-cost example tool chain [f8801, f9308]. Its regulatory-facing evidence includes a description of Euro NCAP's 2026 simulation regime requiring dossiers and spot checks, and an ASAM presentation on UNECE WP.29 NATM credibility assessment; the cited TNO collaboration evidence is mostly road automotive [f1268, f8951, f8830].
